name: ODVBench
l2: 在线自动驾驶视频理解
intro: ODV-Bench 是 StreamForest 论文提出的在线自动驾驶视频理解基准，使用1,190段第一视角驾驶视频构建6,322个多选问答，覆盖静态目标、动态目标和多智能体交互事件三类场景下的12项实时感知、历史记忆、未来预测与风险推理任务。
org: Nanjing University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Zhejiang University, Noah’s Ark Lab at Huawei, Yinwang Intelligent Technology
build_method: 半自动标注, 人工核验, 模板生成
task_type: 在线自动驾驶视频理解, 时空感知, 未来预测
eval_feature: 流式因果约束, 12项任务, 分层准确率
task_type_en: Online autonomous-driving video understanding, spatiotemporal perception, future prediction
build_method_en: Semi-automatic Annotation, Human Verification, Template Generation
eval_feature_en: Causal Streaming Constraint, 12 Tasks, Hierarchical Accuracy
intro_en: ODV-Bench is the online autonomous-driving video-understanding benchmark introduced with StreamForest. It builds 6,322 multiple-choice QA pairs from 1,190 first-person driving clips and covers 12 real-time perception, past-memory, future-prediction, and risk-reasoning tasks across static targets, dynamic targets, and multi-agent interaction events.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.24871 Section 4, Section 5.1, Appendix C, and the official MCG-NJU/StreamForest repository. The diagrams preserve collection from six autonomous-driving datasets, semi-automatic annotation/YOLO filtering plus manual video selection, direct conversion of strong labels versus VLLM+YOLO coarse meta-annotations followed by structured human verification, and the exact three-category statistics: static 247 clips/1,639 questions, dynamic 162/2,973, and event 781/1,710. They retain all 12 tasks, template-based QA generation from fine-grained meta-annotations, option-pool distractors with two to four choices, multiple manual review rounds, video-length-proportional balancing, the final 1,190 unique 5–90-second clips and 6,322 QA pairs with an 18.9-second mean query time, and causal 1-FPS online evaluation using only content available before each query timestamp, with task/category/overall accuracy.
